waivers.reason: OAuth 2.0 for Native Apps. Constrains the authorization-code flow in a native user-agent. SCIMServer has no native-app client and no user-agent redirect flow (client_credentials + jwt-bearer only), so nothing it says applies. Re-evaluate if Phase Q4 ever ships the authorization-code grant.

Deprecating TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 (BCP 195). Already satisfied and independently enforced: Azure Container Apps ingress terminates TLS 1.2+, and the Entra SCIM contract mandates TLS 1.2 with a pinned cipher list. Mirroring the text would add nothing the platform does not already guarantee. Owned by the auth workstream (feat/wif); mirror it there if the auth explainer set is ever extended.

JWS Unencoded Payload Option (b64:false). SCIMServer neither produces nor accepts unencoded-payload JWS; its validators require standard base64url JWS compact serialization. Tracked as an auth-workstream item because a validator that silently honoured b64:false would be a signature-bypass surface.
